title: Slide Runner
howto: Press Play to start the lane run.
Tap or press Left and Right to switch lanes.
Dodge obstacles until the timer ends, then replay to beat your best.
tips: Move early into the safest open lane.
Do not chase every opening; hold a clear lane when traffic stacks.
Use BOOST for a quick score bump if a pattern gets crowded.

controls.keyboard: Left and Right arrows switch lanes; Space starts.
controls.touch: Tap the left or right side to change lanes.

difficulty: Easy and hard adjust the pace of the run while keeping the core objective the same.

cheats.effect: Applies a rainbow hue shift to the whole run.
Gives you a small game-specific advantage.

features.titleCard: A title card explains the run before play starts.
features.results: A result card reports your latest score and best score.
features.bestScore: Best score is stored locally and cheated runs do not overwrite it.
features.tutorial: Tutorial steps are available from the title card and the SDK tutorial hook.
